title: Missing EPIPE handling
detail: The original code handled `OSError` with `errno.EPIPE` by wrapping stdout/stderr and exiting with code 1. The new code only raises for non‑EPIPE errors, silently ignoring EPIPE and letting the exception propagate, which can crash the program or produce an unhandled exception.

title: Incorrect EOF detection in _get_endmarker_and_dedents
detail: When a node is followed by a non-DEDENT leaf that is not the ENDMARKER, the function returns that leaf as the endmarker. The caller then treats it as an EOF node, adding its prefix to the hidden value and clearing it. This incorrectly processes normal code statements as EOF, potentially corrupting formatting and prefix handling.
note: Describes the planted flip: a leaf that isn't the end marker is returned as one.

title: Incorrect logical operator for printing
detail: The original logic printed a blank line only when both the console was non-interactive and not in Jupyter. The new code uses `or`, causing a blank line to be printed when either condition is true, which can produce unwanted output when the console is interactive but not Jupyter, or vice versa.

title: Incorrect lock status check
detail: The Twisted lock object uses a method `locked()` or a property `locked` depending on version; accessing `self._export_lock.locked` without calling it may always be truthy or raise an AttributeError, causing the lock acquisition logic to misbehave.
note: `locked` is an attribute of DeferredLock; not about the dropped await.

title: Acquiring lock without awaiting
detail: Acquiring the lock returns a Deferred that must be awaited; calling it without awaiting may leave the lock in an inconsistent state and cause race conditions.
note: Says the lock is acquired without being awaited.

title: Incorrect logic in accept_html property
detail: The property is supposed to return True when `text/html` is accepted, but the code returns True when it is *not* present, inverting the intended behavior and causing callers to misinterpret the Accept header.
